天在看（天在看（第22页）“因为你的“皇”之位，本质上是我的啊。”“当初，我让你前往九天十地的各个角落，成为我留下的这些痕迹的主人。”“所以，你的本质，是取代的我，也就是说。”“在九天十地的感知中，坐在这天庭神座上的君王，实际上是我，而非你。”“所以，你如果要更上一层楼，那就需要摆脱这个位置，也摆脱目前的这个身份。”“你要禅位，这一步在我看来，是没有问题的。”“我明白了，师尊。”余长浩认真点头。“我会失去眼前的身份，然后再用自己的身份，真正成为世间之主。”“对，就该是这样。”洛长衡微笑。“不过，在这个期间，我不希望你因为要抵达这个境界，而丧失理智。”“毕竟，人在做，天在看！”洛长衡指了指头顶。“天意自古高难问，但天意在，每一座有之地的主宰，都是品行端正之人。”余长浩听完，心中一凛，对那位伟大而神秘的存在的敬畏又多了一分。他对洛长衡行礼。“多谢师尊。”之后几天，洛长衡认真将他认为要告知余长浩的，全部告诉他。直到最后一天。余长浩突然问他。“师尊，您要离开了吗？”洛长衡惊讶看他。“你看出来了。”“看的出来，师尊在向我交代后事，联想到师尊说过的几大有之地，您要回去了。”“是啊。”洛长衡眼眸中浮现坚定。“自从超脱，知先辈故事，如今，也该我了。”

Heaven is Watching (Heaven is Watching (Page 22) "Because your position of "Emperor" is essentially mine." "At the beginning, I asked you to go to every corner of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths to become the master of these traces I left." "So, your essence is to replace me, that is to say." "In the perception of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, the king sitting on this heavenly throne is actually me, not you." "So, if you want to know more To move up a level, you need to get rid of this position and your current identity. "I think there is no problem with this step." "I understand, Master." Yu Changhao nodded seriously. "I will lose my current identity and then use my identity to truly become the master of the world." "Yes, that's what it should be." Luo Changheng smiled. To reach this realm, you lose your mind." "After all, God is watching what people do!" Luo Changheng pointed to the top of his head. "God's will has always been difficult to ask, but God's will is that the master of every land must be a person of good character." After hearing this, Yu Changhao felt a little more awe of that great and mysterious existence. He saluted Luo Changheng. "Thank you, Master." A few days later, Luo Changheng recognized him seriously. I wanted to tell Yu Changhao everything. Until the last day, Yu Changhao suddenly asked him, "Master, are you leaving?" Luo Changheng looked at him in surprise. "You can see that Master is telling me about his future affairs, thinking of what Master said, you are going back." "Yes." Luo Changheng said with determination in his eyes.
